name: Magnitude Browser Agent
description: Vision-first browser agent for TypeScript that navigates, interacts, extracts data and verifies results from natural-language steps.
whatItDoes: Automates web applications and writes end-to-end tests by describing actions and checks in plain language. Developers use it either as an automation library or through the bundled test runner.
howItWorks: The agent looks at screenshots with a visually grounded model and issues pixel-level mouse and keyboard actions rather than relying on DOM selectors. A scaffolding command creates a starter project, and a separate test package wraps the same agent with assertions.

requirements.name: Vision LLM key
requirements.description: Key for a visually grounded model provider

models: Visually grounded models such as Claude
